sourceYearPolicy: Use 2026/current fiction first when it is legally reusable for redistribution. If unavailable, use 2025, then 2024, then the newest verified legally reusable source available. Public-domain Aozora works display their actual first-publication year when known, otherwise a source-edition year.

rights.policy: Only works identified as copyright-expired/public-domain are used in this shelf.
rights.fullTextPolicy: Sakura bundles only short original excerpts and links to the full Aozora work/card.

qualityPolicy.storyText: 100 real Japanese works use short verbatim public-domain source excerpts; no AI-written fiction is bundled.
qualityPolicy.difficulty: Sakura approximate study difficulty only; native works are not JLPT-graded.
qualityPolicy.orthography: Original Aozora transcription is preserved in excerpts.
qualityPolicy.currentness: Publication/edition year is shown honestly; old literature is never labeled as 2026 content.
qualityPolicy.selection: v7 expands Classics, Modern Literature, Mystery & Suspense, Human & Relationships, and Strange / Horror. Works with especially unsuitable discriminatory titles were excluded during source review rather than used to pad counts.
